responsibility: Implements RISC-V ABI computation for C-like and Rust ABIs, including FP-aggregate eligibility analysis, XLEN/FLEN-based register classification, variadic register consumption rules, indirect passing of oversized values, and explicit sign/zero extension behavior for scalar register arguments.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/riscv.rs`, this file computes RISC-V function-call ABI behavior—FP-aggregate eligibility, XLEN/FLEN-sensitive coercions, vararg register use, indirect passing, and Rust-ABI extension attributes—not inline-assembly register parsing.
